mathematical_verification.condition_and_paths: APPROVED: production conditioning is derived from A eigenvalues on the primary path and the stacked day-factor SVD on fallback; all paths are selected from matrix-only diagnostics before outcome statistics.
mathematical_verification.beta_and_covariance: APPROVED: both paths have finite condition-aware coefficient envelopes; fallback bread is V diag(1/s^2) V transpose from the factor SVD, while CR1 meat retains source-day scores, multiplicities and logical N/G.
mathematical_verification.derived_intervals: APPROVED: normwise coefficient radii propagate to named linear contrasts; attenuation and direct ratios fail when denominator intervals contain zero; percentile bounds use ordered endpoint vectors; sign-count p-values require unambiguous interval-side membership.
mathematical_verification.decisions: APPROVED: every effect, confidence-interval, attenuation, ratio, concentration, stability, p-value, FDR and classification boundary is unchanged and overlap is operationally fail-closed.
mathematical_verification.bootstrap: APPROVED: the v10 population, exact year-stratified UTC-day PCG64(22002) draws, multiplicities, 10000 replicates, logical counts, statistics, CR1 convention, percentile method and p-value rules are unchanged.
mathematical_verification.performance: APPROVED: more than 100 fallbacks per 10000-replicate population invalidates before statistics, and the pre-data benchmark/extrapolation uses the worst permitted fallback count.

nonblocking_implementation_requirement: Synthetic tests must exercise inclusive and exclusive threshold endpoint cases and verify outward-rounded intervals, but this is already required by the frozen uniform-decision/fail-close contract.
prohibitions_verified: no market data opened, enumerated, sampled or hashed
no strategy, PnL, execution or LIVE authority
no specification, code or prior evidence modified
